A substitution is offered **only when an ordered item is unavailable at the fulfilling dark store after the order has been accepted** ([1]).
If the substitute is more expensive, Nimbus Now absorbs the difference; if it is cheaper, the price difference is refunded to the customer. [1]
According to the Substitutions Policy, a vegetarian item is **never** substituted with a non‑vegetarian item under any circumstance. [1]
The exclusion exists because caregiver brand and formulation preferences in Baby Care are not interchangeable.” [2]

Personal‑Care substitutions are governed by the following restrictions (all drawn from the Substitutions Policy):
- **Brand‑only substitution:** Personal‑Care items may be substituted **only** across pack sizes of the **identical product**, never across different brands[1].
- **Same‑product, same‑brand rule:** An acceptable substitute must be the same product and same brand, differing only in pack size, **or** the same product from a different brand **within the same category**[3].
- **Price ceiling:** The substitute’s price must be within 15 % of the original line price; any excess is absorbed by Nimbus Now and the customer is never charged more[3].
- **Dietary‑attribute match:** A vegetarian Personal‑Care item can never be swapped for a non‑vegetarian one under any circumstance[3].
- **Storage‑class match:** A chilled Personal‑Care item cannot be replaced with an ambient‑class item[3].
- **Customer consent:** A substitution is never applied silently; the customer receives a notification and has **90 seconds** to accept or reject it before the line is refunded[2].
If that out‑of‑stock line represents **more than 60 percent of the order’s value**, the customer is asked whether to cancel the entire order. [1]
